business.summary: Adhesives and construction/specialty chemicals leader (Fevicol, Dr. Fixit, tile adhesives). Reports Consumer & Bazaar (C&B) and B2B; key input is VAM. FY26 consolidated revenue ₹14,553 Cr (+11.1%), FY26 UVG 11.1% (Q4 FY26 concall). Steers to an EBITDA corridor of 20-24% and double-digit underlying volume growth (UVG).

promises.promise: Hold EBITDA in the 20-24% corridor despite 40-50% inflation in the RM basket, via 12-15% price hikes (Apr-May 2026).
promises.delivered: Standalone EBITDA 26.4% (Q1 FY27), 20.4% (Q2 FY27); H1 23.5% (Q1, Q2 FY27 concalls). Consolidated OPM 26% → 20% (results).

promises.promise: FY27 margin could be 'middle to higher end of the band, easily'.
promises.delivered: Q2 FY27 fell to 20.4%, the lower end, as VAM consumption hit $1,630 (vs $1,370 in Q1); gross margin -720 bps YoY.

promises.promise: Double-digit UVG sustainable at 6-6.5% real GDP, even with price hikes.
UVG momentum (9.8% for 9M FY26) to continue.
H2 FY27 EBITDA within 20-24%, ideally at the slightly higher end, with VAM ~$1,200.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Price hikes have not hurt volume; double-digit UVG for 8 of the last 10 quarters (Q2 FY27 concall).
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Standalone revenue +21.7% with UVG 10.7% in Q2 FY27; +22.2% with 11.3% UVG in Q1 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Margin corridor of 20-24% is robust through the RM cycle.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Consolidated OPM swung 26% (Jun-26) → 20% (Sep-26) in one quarter — at the floor; gross margin -720 bps YoY in Q2 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Operating leverage cushions RM inflation (Q2 FY27 concall).
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: 720 bps gross-margin hit translated into a 430 bps EBITDA decline; PAT ₹626 Cr vs ₹585 Cr YoY (+7%) on +21% sales.

guidance.guide: 20-24% corridor; H2 FY27 at the slightly higher end
Double-digit, aiming to inch up, at 6.5-7% real GDP
~12-15% cumulative hikes taken; partial rebates as VAM eases

bull: Double-digit UVG through 12-15% price hikes: 11.3% (Q1) and 10.7% (Q2 FY27) (Q1, Q2 FY27 concalls).
H1 FY27 EBITDA 23.5%, near the top of the corridor despite VAM nearly doubling (Q2 FY27 concall).
Domestic subsidiaries +22% in Q2 FY27, with C&B and B2B both +22% (Q2 FY27 concall).
bear: VAM at $1,630 in Q2 FY27 vs ~$800-900 in FY26; Q2 EBITDA fell to the 20.4% floor (Q2 FY27 concall).
Large paint competitor has built VAM/VAE capacity; Pidilite has repeatedly chosen not to integrate (Q1, Q2 FY27 concalls).
Q2 FY27 PAT +7% YoY on +21% sales — earnings lag revenue while RM stays volatile (results filings).
